items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: And - like Rudy Wiedoft and Benny End [?] and so forth, you now, see. And they - that's their thing, that terrific attack on the, with the tongue, see.

ctx.x: Well then, he had played saxophone before, he wasn't a beginning student.

Well, I would say beginner, see, because I mean, when I took him, things that he didn't know, how to breath correct, he didn't - and he, and his little tone was straight, because that's all they knew, see. Have you ever heard virtuoso saxophonists play? Have you ever heard a guy like Rudy Wiedoft?
